column1: # comment: Bridge2AI-Voice questionnaire/ and pediatric_questionnaire/ symptom items mapped to HPO phenotypes (PHQ-9, GAD-7, DSM-5, ADHD/ASRS, PTSD, PANAS, custom affect, dyspnea index, Leicester cough, VHI-10, voice perception, pediatric PHQ-A, pediatric voice surveys). Psychosocial-impact, positive-affect, and redundant-facet items are out of scope (see docs/mapping-conventions.md). Every object_id verified against the pinned HPO release with oaklib.

column2: Problems with memory (learning new information) or with location (finding your way home)
